newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK - MARKET CAP AT NEW HIGH.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK - MARKET CAP AT NEW HIGH.

text.p: Gains in Botswana bank shares
swelled the Botswana Stock Exchange's market capitalisation to
its highest level ever of 2.04 billion pula last week.
Barclays Bank of Botswana rose to 13.30 pula from
P12.00; First National Bank gained 35 thebe to 584
thebe; and Standard Chartered Bank of Botswana put on
290 thebe to close at 10.00 pula.
The index closed at 618.57 points.
Among other gainers were brewery holding company Sechaba
Trust which grew 20 thebe at 460 thebe; clothing chain
Pep Holdings' 40 thebe rise to 375 thebe; and milling
company and food wholesaler Sefalana Holdings , which
upped 10 thebe to 540 thebe.
Security group Inco eased 5 thebe to trade at 105
thebe and Botswana Insurance traded unchanged at 305
thebe.
Turnover in domestic stocks was down at 1.51 million shares
from 2.34 million shares the week before, but value traded was
up at 8.32 million pula from 1.76 million pula.
There was no turnover on the foreign, dual listed, board
during the week, but four of the five counters appreciated.
Car rental and fleet management group Avis put on
54 thebe to 741 thebe; De Beers added 87 thebe to
13,235 thebe; professional services group Forbes gained
22 thebe to 789 thebe; McCarthy Retail group closed 57
thebe up at 1,200 thebe. Regent Undervalued Assets Fund was unchanged at 4,000 thebe.
